name: Soap Micelle with Central Oil Droplet
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Chemistry Ch 4 Fig 4.12 & 4.13 3D spherical colloidal soap micelle cluster demonstrating the cleansing action of soap. Features amphiphilic sodium stearate molecules with hydrophobic zigzag hydrocarbon tails (-C17H35) dissolving inwards into a central trapped oil/dirt core, and hydrophilic polar ionic carboxylate heads (-COO-) pointing outwards into water with associated sodium counter-ions (Na+). Dual presentation collections: 'Soap_Micelle_Full' (complete 3D colloidal sphere of 44 soap molecules mounted on a dark studio slate plinth) and 'Soap_Micelle_Section' (hemispherical cutaway revealing the internal trapped grease core, hydrophobic tail penetration, surrounding polar water molecules forming a hydration shell, green emulsification vector arrows, and educational property plaque).
simplifications: 44 radial soap molecules arrayed around central oil sphere with authentic zigzag hydrocarbon chains.
Cutaway view includes surrounding polar Mickey Mouse water molecules (H2O) forming hydration shell.
Section view includes emulsification vector arrows demonstrating mechanical lifting of oily dirt.
